First release candidate of SANKHYA, the LP / MILP / convex QP solver written from scratch for Smart India Hackathon 2026, problem statement SIH26119 (Mangalore Refinery and Petrochemicals Ltd).

## Download

| archive | for |
|---|---|
| `sankhya-*-linux-x86_64-cpu.tar.gz` | Linux x86-64, glibc 2.35 or later |
| `sankhya-*-linux-x86_64-cuda.tar.gz` | Linux x86-64 with an NVIDIA driver; the CUDA runtime is linked in |
| `sankhya-*-windows-x64-cpu.zip` | Windows 10 / 11 x64 |

No compiler is needed. Unpack, then from the unpacked directory:

    build/sankhya version
    build/sankhya solve demo/crude_blend.mps --write-sol blend.sol
    python3 tools/verify_solution.py demo/crude_blend.mps blend.sol
    demo/finale.sh                     # Windows: demo\finale.cmd

Container (CUDA build, the verifier and the demo models):

    docker pull ghcr.io/thegoodengineers/sankhya:v1.0.0-rc1
    docker run --rm --gpus all ghcr.io/thegoodengineers/sankhya:v1.0.0-rc1 sankhya solve demo/crude_blend.mps --gpu

Check a download against `SHA256SUMS`. Each archive's `MANIFEST.txt` records the commit, compiler and CUDA toolkit it was built with and the libraries it links; CI fails the packaging if any of them is an optimization solver. This pre-release has no Windows CUDA archive; the release workflow builds one from the next tag on (MSVC host compiler, CUDA 12.6 toolkit, compiled without a card).

## Measured on main, from the CSVs in bench/results/

- Netlib, the 92 LPs netlib.org ships, 120 s each (`netlib-full-9094e1c.csv`): 90 within 1e-6 of Koch's exact optima and independently verified, 82 match the readme's published optimum, 92 return an answer the independent verifier accepts.
- Maros-Meszaros, all 138 convex QPs at 60 s (`maros-meszaros-9094e1c.csv`): optimal on 106, within 1e-6 of the reference on 106, verifier-accepted on 120, no optimal answer the verifier rejects.
- MIPLIB 2017, 30 easy instances at 60 s (`miplib-ad57c03.csv`): 14 reach the published optimum, 11 prove it.
- Scenarios (`scenarios-de0f393a.csv`): 1130 scenarios, every one verified and equal to its separate single solve to 1e-8 relative.

The full evidence, including what does not work yet, is in `README.md` and `docs/BENCHMARKS.md` at the tagged commit.
